intent.raw: Create an Invoke Define, Design, and Plan development package for capacity-aware Orchestrate admission.
intent.objective: Specify and plan whole-wave admission, honest failed-spawn evidence, host-authority ceilings, route alternatives, and generated parity without implementing runtime changes.
intent.operator_sentence: Plan the smallest capacity-safe Orchestrate update and hand off one non-authorized SWU at a time.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The requested authoring route is sequential; one bounded read-only helper reviewed evidence and later balanced the Plan.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No governed implementation dispatch was executed and no native implementation agents were spawned.

steps.name: Bind incident and canonical source evidence
stop_conditions: Stop if private incident evidence would be copied into public Arcanum prose or fixtures.

steps.name: Author Define Design and Plan
stop_conditions: Stop on a hard-coded or inferred host limit, fabricated agent identity, implicit route change, or implementation mutation.

steps.name: Balance plan boundaries and recomposition
stop_conditions: Block if any SWU is task-shaped, cannot recompose, lacks exact boundaries, or invents host authority.

steps.name: Hand off exactly the first SWU for fresh preflight
stop_conditions: No mutation until a current Context Builder pack and material binding validate for exactly SWU-OCA-001.

gates.condition: Define, deterministic Design, implementation-grade Plan, and Distill result are complete and consistent.
Future public runtime changes remain generic and contain no private incident, product, account, or filesystem prose.
A Task Session preflight and material binding separately authorize exactly one SWU.

boundaries.contract: Only abstract generic behavior crosses; private paths, verbatim errors, account assumptions, and product prose do not.
The host owns capacity, reservation, physical release, and reuse truth; Orchestrate validates immutable evidence without inference.
The Work Pack selects but does not authorize SWU-OCA-001; execution requires fresh context, material, baseline, and owner receipts.
Canonical source changes first; generated packages update only by isolated generation and exact-directory sync.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns Define, Design, Plan, and Refresh; Task Session owns one selected SWU execution.
authority.execution: No implementation execution is authorized by this authoring dispatch.
authority.validation: Deterministic Design selection, Distill, Dispatch Spec, Task Session tests, and independent recomposition retain separate receipts.
authority.evidence: Host evidence owns capacity facts; package evidence owns only authored contracts and validation results.
authority.promotion: No publication, deployment, release, or production authority.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Authoring and later receipt updates only.
Forbidden in authoring; exact selected SWU only after Task Session admission.

promotion_splits.rule: Requires fresh Task Session preflight, exact material binding, baseline, and explicit mutation authority.
Requires separate host-owned lifecycle evidence; never infer.

promotion_guardrails: A validated plan is not implementation.
A capacity snapshot is not a reservation.
A logical close is not physical release.
A generated parity pass is not publication or release.
